preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 3 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all('A' <= char <= 'Z' for char in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string s are uppercase English letters.
The string s contains at least three different characters.

postconditions.expression: all(ord(result[i]) > ord(result[i + 1]) for i in range(len(result) - 1))
postconditions.description: The characters in the result string are in descending order of their ASCII values.

postconditions.expression: any((ord(result[i]) - ord(result[i + 1])) == d for d in range(1, 26) for i in range(len(result) - 1))
postconditions.description: The characters in the result string form an arithmetic progression with a common difference of at least 1.

postconditions.expression: len(result) == max(len(subseq) for subseq in subsequences if all(ord(subseq[i]) > ord(subseq[i + 1]) for i in range(len(subseq) - 1)) and any((ord(subseq[i]) - ord(subseq[i + 1])) == d for d in range(1, 26) for i in range(len(subseq) - 1)))
postconditions.description: The result string has the maximum possible length among all valid subsequences.

postconditions.expression: all(char in s for char in result)
postconditions.description: All characters in the result string are present in the original string s.
